description: NetEase UU Remote: remote desktop and remote game streaming from any device
notes: The vendor only ships an NSIS installer, which registers a Windows service (GameViewerService, an autostart service), a virtual display driver and an 'Upgrade.exe' self-updater. This manifest unpacks the installer payload instead, so none of that happens: no service, no driver, no startup entry and no self-update.
Because the service is not installed, the app runs in client mode only. Remote-control/session hosting from this machine requires the official installer with administrator rights.
The bundled 'Upgrade.exe' is deleted during install. Update with 'scoop update uu远程'.
Settings and logs are kept in 'config' and 'log' next to the executable; 'config' is persisted so pairings survive updates.
pre_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -gt 1) { throw "Failed to unpack the UU Remote installer (7z exit code $LASTEXITCODE)." }
if ($null -eq $payload) { throw 'NSIS payload directory not found inside the UU Remote installer.' }
